$comment: The ONE place the mobile apps' target environment is described. Chosen at build time by LT_APP_ENV (default qa) -- see docs/mobile-release.md 'The environment switch'. Read by capacitor.config.ts, scripts/app-env.mjs (Portal .env.mobile.local + iOS Environment.xcconfig), scripts/check-bundle.mjs, scripts/app-links.mjs and android/app/build.gradle. Nothing here is a secret: the Firebase API key, app ids and sender id stay in the off-repo env file.

appLinks.$comment: Universal Links / App Links. Filled by the owner once the Apple team and the signing keys exist (docs/mobile-release.md, owner checklist). Empty = scripts/app-links.mjs writes nothing, so no host claims the app by accident.
